title: 第1章 郑拓的黑名单第2章 苟住别浪
slug: 这个主角明明很强却异常谨慎
content_zh:
东域。
落仙宗。
山脚下人满为患。
今日为落仙宗十年一度，招收弟子的大日子。
人潮化长龙，络绎不绝，从远方蔓延至山顶。
浩浩荡荡，好不壮观。
“师兄，今年的新人还真是多呢，怕是已足有数万人。”
负责迎新的师妹昂首挺胸，双手背在身后，看上去十分享受周围投来的一道道爱慕目光。
“这算什么。”师兄开口道：“我听闻，在东域中心，有超级仙朝坐落，其招收弟子时，何止数万人，简直成十万成百万成千万，连起来能绕东域一圈还拐个弯。”
“成百万，成千万，是真的吗师兄？”
师妹眼中满是崇拜的望着师兄。
师兄在感受到师妹崇拜的目光后，顿时感觉自己又高大几分。
抬手，拍拍师妹香肩，意味深长的说道：“师妹，莫要羡慕他人宗门，要知道，我们落仙宗曾有仙人降临，如此贵气，岂是其它凡间宗门可比，好好修行，从你面相上来看，落仙宗崛起的重任，就抗在你的肩膀上，加油！！！”
“真的吗？师兄。”
师妹眼中的光芒大胜。
“当然，你师兄我别的本事没有，在看面相这件事上，我说第二，整个凡界没有人敢称第一，回头来我洞府，我好好给你看看面相，顺便检查检查你的修为是否有长进。”
“嗯，谢谢师兄。”
师妹俏脸一红，满脸迫不及待。
师兄妹望着络绎不绝上山拜师的人群，谈论着宗门之事。
与此同时。

距离二者520米左右，一褐色岩石的背后，正有一位少年屏住呼吸，眼如鹰隼，身如磐石，将自己隐藏在黑暗中。
少年名为郑拓，穿越者，已经穿越到这个世界十六年。
打他知道这是个有神仙的世界后，就开始探查，研究，钻研……
终于，在经过十年的准备后，他决定加入落仙宗，成为一名修仙者。
至于为什么要准备十年，当然是因为谨慎。
至于为什么谨慎，是因为在父母出车祸后，他得了一种精神疾病。
被迫害妄想症。
简单点来讲，就是总感觉有刁民想害朕。
如此，让他变得十分小心谨慎。
甚至到了吹毛求疵，鸡蛋里挑骨头，吃饭要试毒，上厕所不让人看的变态程度。
想起自己的病症，郑拓从上衣兜里掏出一枚黑色小本本。
小本本上密密麻麻，记载有许多重要信息。
翻开第二十页，上面有明确记载。
名称：落仙宗。
级别：中级宗门。
宗主：云万里。
content_en:
Eastern Region.
Luo Xian Sect.
The foothills were crowded.
Today is a big day for Luo Xian Sect to recruit disciples once every ten years.
The crowds of people turned into long queues, flowing in an endless stream, spreading from afar to the top of the mountain.
It's so majestic and spectacular.
"Senior brother, there are really many newcomers this year. I'm afraid there are tens of thousands of people."
The junior sister in charge of welcoming new students held her head high and her hands behind her back, looking like she was enjoying the admiring looks from around her.
"What's this?" Senior Brother said, "I heard that there is a Super Immortal Dynasty located in the center of the Eastern Territory. When it recruits disciples, there are not only tens of thousands of people, but hundreds of thousands, millions, tens of millions. If they are connected together, they can go around the Eastern Territory and turn a corner."
"Millions, tens of millions, is it true, senior brother?"
The junior sister looked at the senior brother with admiration in her eyes.
After the senior brother felt the admiring gaze of his junior sister, he suddenly felt a little taller.
He raised his hand, patted Junior Sister's shoulder, and said meaningfully: "Junior Sister, don't envy other sects. You must know that our Luoxian Sect once had immortals come to us. How can we be so noble and noble as other mortal sects? Practice well. Judging from your appearance, the important task of the rise of Luoxian Sect will be on your shoulders. Come on!!!"
"Really? Senior brother."
The gleam in the junior sister's eyes was overwhelming.
"Of course, your senior brother, I don't have any other skills. When it comes to reading faces, I say second place. No one in the entire mortal world dares to be ranked first. Come back to my cave and I will give you a good look at your face. I will also check to see if your cultivation has improved."
"Well, thank you, senior brother."
The junior sister's pretty face turned red, her face filled with impatience.
The senior brothers and sisters looked at the crowds of people who came up the mountain to worship as masters, and talked about the sect.
at the same time.
About 520 meters away from the two, behind a brown rock, there is a young man holding his breath, with eyes like an eagle and a body like a rock, hiding himself in the darkness.
The young man's name is Zheng Tuo, a time traveler who has been in this world for sixteen years.
After he knew that this was a world with gods, he began to explore, study, and study...
Finally, after ten years of preparation, he decided to join the Luoxian Sect and become an immortal cultivator.
As for why we need to prepare for ten years, of course it is because of caution.
As for why he was cautious, it was because he suffered from a mental illness after his parents had a car accident.
Paranoia of persecution.
To put it simply, I always feel that there are unscrupulous people who want to harm me.
This made him very cautious.
Even to the point of being picky and picky, trying poison when eating, and not letting others watch when going to the toilet.
Thinking of his illness, Zheng Tuo took out a small black notebook from his jacket pocket.
The small notebook is densely packed with important information.
Turning to page 20, there is a clear record on it.
Name: Luo Xian Sect.
Level: Intermediate sect.
Sect Master: Yun Wanli.
